title: Cboe Macro Volatility Actor Input Schema

lookbackPeriod.title: Historical Lookback Period
lookbackPeriod.description: Lookback period for historical volatility series and 1-year percentiles.

correlationWindowDays.title: Correlation Window (Trading Days)
correlationWindowDays.description: Number of trading days for rolling cross-asset correlation matrix (default 21 days = 1 Month).

includeCorrelationMatrix.title: Include Cross-Asset Correlation Matrix
includeCorrelationMatrix.description: Compute full pairwise correlation matrix across equities, commodities, crypto, FX, and rates.

includeHistoricalSeries.title: Include Historical Time Series
includeHistoricalSeries.description: Include daily historical time series of Cboe volatility indices (VIX, VVIX, SKEW, etc.).
